source.title: Morozov talks about future supermatches against Jerry and Ermes
source.description:
Morozov talks about future supermatches against Jerry and Ermes

In one of Engin Terzi's latest podcasts, Artyom Morozov has commented that in future supermatches against Jerry Cadorette and Ermes Gasparini his chances of winning them are 80-70%.

Source: 
Engin Terzi's channel: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=loXnahgesfw
